title: North Melbourne AFLW duo announce retirement after historic three-peat
summary: Inaugural AFLW Kangaroos captain and eight-time All Australian Emma Kearney has announced her retirement following North Melbourne's third straight premiership victory alongside teammate and partner Kate Shierlaw.

title: The tactics that secured North Melbourne's third AFLW premiership
summary: The AFLW champions were tested, but in three specific phases of the game, North Melbourne made history by winning another grand final.
